claims.pass_condition: Neutral intent, package, graph, binding, plan, and run schemas parse and are declared by the module.
claims.primary_surface: JSON parsing plus manifest/contract seam review
claims.counterevidence: A schema fails to parse or is absent from the declared handoff surface.
claims.observed_evidence: All changed JSON parsed; discovery seam review passed.

claims.pass_condition: Identical neutral inputs produce the same sealed portable plan and exact portable-to-internal binding.
claims.primary_surface: Repeated executable compilation with digest equality assertions
claims.counterevidence: Equivalent inputs produce different plan or binding digests.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Resume requires the exact same portable and internal plan identities.
claims.observed_evidence: Repeated compilation and terminal resume passed with exact digest equality.

claims.pass_condition: A documentation-domain fixture executes three ordered packages and reaches candidate-ready with neutral plan and run receipts.
claims.primary_surface: Focused in-process fixture execution in an external temporary job root
claims.counterevidence: The domain is rewritten to game, ordering fails, evidence is missing, or the neutral receipt is absent.
claims.observed_evidence: Documentation fixture reached CANDIDATE_READY and preserved axm.production-run/v1 beside internal evidence.

claims.pass_condition: Adaptation grants no execution authority; missing verifiers hold; execution requires the portable phrase; altered bindings or authority receipts are refused.
claims.primary_surface: Allowed and denied focused boundary tests
claims.counterevidence: A plan executes without the portable phrase, passes without a verifier, or resumes from altered authority evidence.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: Sealed adapter and run receipts retain install, promote, canon, and release as false.
claims.observed_evidence: Missing-verifier, wrong-phrase, resealed-reference-tamper, and portable-receipt-tamper checks all held as designed.

claims.pass_condition: Several real domains execute through neutral Hands and neutral step receipts without game-specific internal contracts.
claims.primary_surface: Held-out real domain pipelines plus contract inspection
claims.counterevidence: Any required step still depends on game-specific receipt or execution semantics.
claims.observed_evidence: The v0.1 adapter intentionally retains axm.game-step-receipt/v1 internally.

claims.pass_condition: An appointed domain reviewer accepts a representative real output against declared criteria.
claims.primary_surface: Representative artifact inspection and human/domain review
claims.counterevidence: The fixture passes mechanically but the produced artifact is incomplete, wrong, or undesirable.
claims.observed_evidence: Only inert fixture facts exist; no domain-quality review was requested or performed.
